title: Forest, bolder
question: Still deep green and Geist, now bigger, more colour and more feel. Every variant gets the same feel: numbers count up, buttons press down with a spring, a sorted payment ticks off. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: D · Deep Forest
options.lineage: Forest Card, colour taken all the way
options.thesis: The whole app is green: a dark forest ground, lighter green panels, the number in mint at full size.
options.viewport: Green everywhere; €1.180 huge in mint; pace line in mint; Needs you as an amber-edged panel; pill tab bar.
options.risk: A lot of one colour; long lists on Money need lighter rows to stay readable.

options.label: E · Big Tiles
options.lineage: Forest Card with chunky, tappable blocks
options.thesis: Green hero card, then needs, wants and savings as big coloured tiles with thick rings you want to tap.
options.viewport: Green card with the number; three tiles in mint, peach and sky with rings; a sorting card in peach with one big button.
options.risk: Tiles are a common pattern; the rings must carry real numbers, not decoration.

options.label: F · Card Stack
options.thesis: Cards stacked like a wallet: free-to-spend on top, what needs you peeking out behind it in amber.
options.viewport: A giant green card with €1.180 at 88px; an amber card behind it reading '3 to sort'; a blue card for still to pay; tabs below.
options.risk: Stacked cards hide content behind a swipe; the top card must answer the question alone.
